0022600106.text: The 76ers, 1-0 and first in the Atlantic, host the 0-1 Milwaukee Bucks, who are fourth in the Central, in a regular-season game. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, ruptured Achilles), Dean Wade (out, ankle sprain), Dominick Barlow (out, back) and Tacko Fall (out, quadriceps). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Philadelphia won the four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 126-106 in Philadelphia on April 12, 2026.
